newsitem.title: USA: Executive Risk Q4 net shr $0.85 vs $0.56.
newsitem.headline: Executive Risk Q4 net shr $0.85 vs $0.56.

text.p: Executive Risk Inc said Thursday it posted operating earnings for the fourth quarter of 1996 of $7.5 million, or $0.74 per share, as compared to $6.5 million, or $0.54 per share, for the fourth quarter of 1995.
For the year ended December 31, operating earnings were $27.4 million, or $2.60 per share, in 1996, as compared to $24.3 million, or $2.02 per share, in 1995.

Net income for the fourth quarter of 1996 was $8.6 million, or $0.85 per share, as compared to $6.7 million, or $0.56 per share, for the fourth quarter of 1995. For the year ended December 31, 1996 net income was $28.1 million, or $2.67 per share, as compared to $25.3 million, or $2.11 per share, in 1995.

Year-to-year comparisons of reported financial results are not meaningful because of the repurchase of 2,511,300 shares of capital stock from The Aetna Casualty and Surety Company on March 26, 1996, and the sale of 300,000 shares of common stock upon exercise by the underwriters of an over-allotment option in connection with the secondary offering of the common stock on June 7, 1996.

Adjusting 1995's results on a comparable basis (assuming the repurchase and sale occurred on the same dates in 1995), ERI's operating earnings per share would have increased 28%, from $0.58 in the fourth quarter of 1995 to $0.74 per share in the fourth quarter of 1996, and 21%, from $2.14 to $2.60 per share, for the year ended December 31, 1995 and December 31, 1996, respectively.
